messages:
Implement JSON Patch (RFC 6902)

applyPatch(document, patch) applies the six operations - add, remove,
replace, move, copy and test - in order, to a copy of the document: the
caller's document and patch are left untouched, and a patch that fails
half-way through leaves nothing behind, since the copy is dropped with
the error.

The operations are built on the JSON Pointer evaluation that is already
here, so they agree on what a location is: only own members are
reachable, array indices are decimal without leading zeros, and "-" is
the position after the last element, which only "add" can use.
